name: Magma Opus
oracle_text:
Magma Opus deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. Tap two target permanents. Create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token. Draw two cards.
{U/R}{U/R}, Discard this card: Create a Treasure token.
blocked_sentences: Magma Opus deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.

needs.what: damage `divided` over a target spec of kind "any" (creatures, planeswalkers, battles AND players), so the 601.2d announcement offers players a share and resolution deals each player target its share
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `damage` with `divided` exists, but `Game._ask_damage_division` keeps only declared refs with `kind == "object"` and `ops_life._damage_divided` deals each share through `damage_permanent`, so a player chosen as one of the 'any number of targets' would receive no damage at all. It works only for permanent-only specs (Monstrous Onslaught's 'target creatures'); restricting this card to permanents would be an approximation
